title: Sue Seungap lam Ruang .
intro: Saboh doa nyang meugema lam keuadaan seungap saboh kama suci nyang ka treb that, jibeudôh nibak jiwa nyang ka tuha nyang meuheut keu peue nyang ka jipeugah lé donya hana mungken. Tokoh nyoe, nyang ka maju lam thon-thon dan beuban ngon khawatir keu masa ukeue, meugisa ubak Tuhan awaknyan deungon saboh doa pribadi. Nyang seulanjut jih na kheueh tanggapan ilahi nyang meulawan ngon tiep-tiep harapan alam-saboh bukti keuhai rahmat Gobnyan nyang geujaweueb panggilan nyang putôh asa.
clues: Lon meudoá ubak Tuhan lon lam keuadaan pribadi, lon tarek droe u dalam saboh kama teumpat lon peuseumah droe lon keu ibadat Gobnyan.
Lon meungaku bak Tuhan lon bahwa lon teumakot keu ureung-ureung nyang akan teuka lheuh lon, khawatir keu bimbingan umat lon watee lon beurangkat.
Usia tuha ka jijak keunong ulôn—tuleueng-tuleueng ulôn ka leumoh dan ôk putéh ka meutabu ateueh ulée ulôn.
Pasangan lon ka mandul seulama udep jih, teuma lon mantong lon lakee bak Tuhan lon mangat geubri keu lon sidroe ahli wareh nibak hadirat Gobnyan keudroe.
Lon lakee tanda, dan Tuhan lon geujaweub deungon geucegah lon peugah haba ngon soe mantong seulama lhee malam, seudangkan lon teutap sehat secara fisik.
Lon geujanjikan sidroe aneuk agam nyang nan jih Yahya, nan nyang Tuhan lon peugah hana tom geubri keu soe mantong seugolom jih.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
